generator.program.note: The lineage's own program (growth plan G2.3a), on the broadleaf base: it gives the values its species leave unset, which the broadleaf program gave as defaults until then.

traits.note: Hutchinson (vol. 1, 2nd ed., 1959), family 62 Fagaceae, under which he kept Nothofagus (APG's Nothofagaceae): trees; leaves simple, pinnately veined, with stipules soon falling; flowers unisexual on the same tree, a calyx and no petals; the female in a cup of scales; fruit small nuts in that cup.

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: APweb, Fagales page, Nothofagaceae (read 2026-10-16): leaves two-ranked (or spiral).

traits.inflorescence.note: APweb, Fagales page, Nothofagaceae (read 2026-10-16): staminate and carpellate flowers in dichasia of 1-3(-5); not catkins, so the order's catkin is wrong here.

traits.leaf_habit.note: APweb Fagales page notes deciduous species; evergreen majority (New Zealand, New Guinea, Tasmania) is my knowledge. Medium confidence.

traits.stamens.note: APweb, Fagales page, Nothofagaceae (read 2026-10-16): stamens 10-15 or many.
